szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing ElevenAgents Campaign Manager, built to help the teams who run outbound campaigns achieve their outcomes.

Give it your contacts and a goal, like a qualified lead or a confirmed appointment. It follows up with each contact over time to get there, carrying context between every touch.

If someone doesn’t pick up a call, it tries again later. If they ask for a call back on Thursday at 4 pm, it calls then. If they give a different point of contact, it calls that person next.

Every campaign shows the whole funnel, from enrollment to outcome. See how many contacts have hit the goal, how many haven’t been reached yet, and who needs your attention.

Campaign Manager follows the calling hours and attempt limits you set, and stops contacting anyone who opts out.

Campaigns run over phone calls and WhatsApp today, with email and SMS coming soon.
